description: Small curated development benchmark over the bundled canonical corpus. Each positive label has an inspected verbatim span at the stored chunk starting page. Labels are not exhaustive; unjudged documents are not proven irrelevant. Grades: 2 directly addresses the requested evidence, 1 provides relevant contextual evidence. DOC007 and DOC008 duplicate a publication and are separate catalog IDs, not independent studies. Queries were curated with corpus access and are not a held-out test set.
corpus_notes: Physical page_number is the first page of a stored chunk; spans may continue onto subsequent pages.

Catalog titles and years can differ from text printed in documents: DOC012 is titled Invasive Carp Strategic Science Plan in the catalog, but the text says Strategic Framework, 2023-27; DOC003 is cataloged as a 2024 update but contains 1998 Update text. Labels assert only the inspected stored evidence, not the accuracy of catalog dates.

Offline keyword and document lookup measurements do not measure live embedding or generated-answer quality. Low scores are findings for this small partial benchmark, not a full-corpus accuracy estimate.

cases.question: How do zebra mussels affect water infrastructure and hydropower operations?

judgments.exact_span: Dreissenid mussels foul critical infrastructure (gates, valve tunnels, timber cribbing on navigation structures, lock and dam surfaces, intake openings and pipes, cooling water strainers, water sensors, etc.), cause pitting and increase corrosion of hydraulic steel structures (Figure 3), reduce capacity for hydropower generation, and increase maintenance costs.
judgments.reason: Direct description of physical infrastructure and operational impacts.

cases.question: What percentage increase in maintenance tasks was reported at Gavins Point due to zebra mussel fouling?

judgments.exact_span: The USACE Omaha District reported a 50% increase in operations and maintenance tasks at the Gavins Point hydropower facility due to zebra mussel and Asian clam fouling of raw water pipes in penstocks, heat exchangers and water cooling systems.
judgments.reason: Contains a measured 50% maintenance change; includes both zebra mussels and Asian clams, not control efficacy.
